metadata.conversion_note: The DOCX source was omitted from the release. Paragraphs, heading structure, tables, run emphasis, and embedded image assets were converted into JSON and ordinary asset files.

content.text: Core tests, Beats, harm, investigations, journeys, covenants, alignment, and conversion in a compact form.
Roll d20 + ability modifier + proficiency when trained. State intent, approach, effect, and risk before a consequential roll.
Edge/Burden: roll 2d20, or 3d20 at rating 2, and keep the best/worst. Each cancels the other.
Resolve: maximum 3. Spend 1 for +1d6 after a d20, reduce Stress by 2, resist eligible Claim pressure, or declare modest plausible preparation.
Push: after a failed non-attack test, change the approach and accept a stronger predeclared risk; reroll once with Edge.
Reaction: one between the end of your turn and the start of the next. Guard: spend after damage to reduce it by PB + Guard value.
Essential clue + plausible access + competent approach = the clue is found. Roll for speed, completeness, secrecy, danger, and extra leverage.
Use Progress and Danger clocks. Breakthrough normally fills 2 Progress; Clean success 1; Costly opening 1 Progress and 1 Danger; Setback 1 Danger; Crisis 2 Danger.
Journey roles: Guide, Scout, Quartermaster, Envoy, Specialist. Pace: Cautious, Steady, or Urgent.
Social rolls change willingness, cost, timing, or chosen options. They never erase a hard Boundary, bodily autonomy, identity, or obvious reality.
Alignment records behavior. Reputation records what observers believe. Neither controls a player character.
Record faction, settlement, relationship, and legal consequences only for observers with knowledge.
Review meaningful alignment movement, Resonance, Claim, Convictions, and Resolve.
Confirm every player received meaningful spotlight and identify optional next hooks.

rows: Player may accept success with a stated cost
Attack action including Extra Attack, or standard offensive cantrip
One translated bonus-action feature per turn
Guard / Disengage / Dash / Hide / Assist / Interact
Prepare a 1- or 2-Beat action using the Reaction
Once/round, mark 2 Stress; no leveled spell, Swift, or repeat Strike
Half maximum HP or fewer; no universal penalty
1 minute; spend one Hit Die or clear 1 Stress, once per Field Rest
10 minutes; Hit Dice, Guard, short-rest features, limited Stress recovery
8 hours; long-rest resources, half Hit Dice, heal to half then spend dice, clear ordinary Stress
Choose Fall into Dying or Stand for 2 final Beats and gain one Wound
Use Heroic, Perilous, or Brutal choice agreed at Session Zero
Player currency gained by accepting meaningful identity-based cost
Clarity and benefit of the class covenant; starts 3
Direct divine access and obligation; starts 0
Pressure from freely violating Major/Defining Convictions
Demonstrated behavior across eight independent questions
Telegraphed Reaction or extra initiative slot
